precedence.behavior: If present, return its Path::parent; no fallback when that parent is absent.

active_path: 0x145421220 returns WOW_ROGUE_SAVE directly when present; otherwise appends characters.txt to the base directory.
import_backup: 0x145420cf0 appends fixed characters.before-import.txt to that directory; 0x145402ca0 ignores the backup writer result and proceeds with ordinary persistence.
limitations: Original Windows environment/path encoding failures outside these explicit branches are not newly characterized by this manifest.
Rebuilt integration and QA directory isolation are parent-owned and require validation.
